transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the access-plan review for tomorrow's four support visits. We've got the vehicle-inspection team, the water-system contractor, the network-maintenance team, and the refrigerated repair-parts delivery. I need to check each one with security, facilities, signal, and logistics before I sign off. Let's work through them one at a time. Who wants to start with the vehicle-inspection team?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Whitfield, on the vehicle-inspection team: their current access authorization is valid only through Gate 2 at 1000, and a security escort must be assigned. I confirmed the authorization with the guard-desk supervisor this morning, but the updated pass record has not yet been posted.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Whitfield, on the water-system contractor: I measured their 3.8-meter-wide service unit against the gate plans today. It cannot clear Gates 1, 2, or 3 — it must use Service Gate 4 at 0800, and we'll need a facilities spotter for the approach. The receiving-yard notice has not yet been updated to reflect this.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Col. Whitfield, on the network-maintenance team: their equipment requires the shielded access route through Gate 1 at 1300, and a signal escort must meet the team there. I received the equipment compatibility confirmation from the network section this morning, but it is not yet on the access brief.
transcript.speaker: A4
